name: Dapaong

routes.outcome: Official DCCFE contacts page lists Division Régionale Dapaong, establishing a local cadastral/conservation-foncière custodian. It provides contact information only; no map or parcel response was requested.

Official OTR/DCCFE site exposes cadastre, conservation foncière, legal documents, procedures and land-service links. HTML and JavaScript inspection found no public map viewer, ArcGIS/GeoServer endpoint, or anonymous parcel API.
Official cadastre mission page describes the national computerized technical, fiscal and legal land archive. This is general national-agency prose, not Dapaong geometry or service coverage evidence.
Official OTR notice establishes the national Numéro Unique Parcellaire (NUP) from 2024-08-01. It does not expose a parcel lookup endpoint or a Dapaong feature response.
Official integrated-management host returned an error page during direct GET. No login was attempted, no credentials/private token used, and no protected workflow was probed.
Official Journal result contains a Dapaong/Tantigou immatriculation notice and descriptive legal parcel text, but no safe polygon geometry or public native parcel identifier suitable for retention.

boundedAnonymousResponse.requestScope: No public anonymous parcel feature endpoint was evidenced, so no bounded ID+geometry request was made.

localCustodianAssessment: The DCCFE contacts page directly identifies Division Régionale Dapaong, making this local registry/cadastre custodian evidence. OTR/DCCFE national pages and the NUP notice are national agency evidence; they do not prove a Dapaong public data service or citywide coverage.

qualification.reason: A local Dapaong cadastral custodian is evidenced, but no anonymous parcel schema, CRS, safe native identity, public geometry response, or citywide service coverage was independently qualified.

uncertainty: Dapaong has direct official local-custodian evidence through the OTR/DCCFE regional division listing, and Togo has official cadastral/NUP documentation. An anonymous public parcel viewer/API, native parcel IDs, CRS, geometry, and citywide coverage remain unverified. Runtime adapter qualification remains held for serial review.
